name: CRM Workflow 2 - Cảnh báo Khủng hoảng & Lỗi lô hàng

parameters.query:
=SELECT 
  s.lot_id,
  s.issue_type,
  MAX(s.product_id) AS product_id,
  COUNT(*)::int AS cluster_size,
  MIN(s.created_at) AS earliest_review,
  MAX(s.created_at) AS latest_review,
  STRING_AGG('• ' || REPLACE(s.review_text, E'\n', ' '), E'\n') AS review_samples,
  '{{ $json.sim_now }}'::timestamptz AS sim_now,
  '{{ $json.window_start }}'::timestamptz AS window_start,
  {{ $json.threshold }}::int AS threshold,
  {{ $json.cooldown_hours }}::int AS cooldown_hours
FROM scenario_reviews s
WHERE s.issue_type <> 'none'
  AND (('{{ $json.scenario_set }}' = '') OR (s.scenario_set = '{{ $json.scenario_set }}'))
  AND s.created_at >= '{{ $json.window_start }}'::timestamptz
  AND s.created_at <= '{{ $json.sim_now }}'::timestamptz
GROUP BY s.lot_id, s.issue_type
HAVING COUNT(*) >= {{ $json.threshold }}
ORDER BY cluster_size DESC;

=SELECT 
  '{{ $json.lot_id }}' AS lot_id,
  '{{ $json.issue_type }}' AS issue_type,
  '{{ $json.product_id }}' AS product_id,
  {{ $json.cluster_size }}::int AS cluster_size,
  {{ $json.threshold }}::int AS threshold,
  '{{ $json.sim_now }}'::timestamptz AS sim_now,
  '{{ $json.window_start }}'::timestamptz AS window_start,
  {{ $json.cooldown_hours }}::int AS cooldown_hours,
  $review_samples${{ $json.review_samples }}$review_samples$ AS review_samples,
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM alerts a
    WHERE a.lot_id = '{{ $json.lot_id }}'
      AND a.issue_type = '{{ $json.issue_type }}'
      AND a.status <> 'false_alarm'
      AND a.created_at >= ('{{ $json.sim_now }}'::timestamptz - INTERVAL '{{ $json.cooldown_hours }} hours')
  ) AS is_in_cooldown;

=INSERT INTO alerts (
  lot_id, issue_type, product_id, cluster_size, threshold,
  window_start, window_end, sim_now, incident_summary, root_cause, evidence, severity, status, created_at
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.lot_id }}',
  '{{ $json.issue_type }}',
  '{{ $json.product_id }}',
  {{ $json.cluster_size }},
  {{ $json.threshold }},
  '{{ $json.window_start }}'::timestamptz,
  '{{ $json.window_end }}'::timestamptz,
  '{{ $json.sim_now }}'::timestamptz,
  $body${{ $json.incident_summary }}$body$,
  $body${{ $json.root_cause }}$body$,
  $body${{ $json.evidence }}$body$,
  '{{ $json.severity }}',
  '{{ $json.status }}',
  '{{ $json.sim_now }}'::timestamptz
)
RETURNING alert_id, lot_id, issue_type, status, created_at;
